name: β-hydroxyfentanyl
summary: β-Hydroxyfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of fentanyl.

uses.text: β-Hydroxyfentanyl was sold briefly on the black market in the early 1980s, before the introduction of the Federal Analog Act which for the first time attempted to control entire families of drugs based on their structural similarity rather than scheduling each drug individually as they appeared.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl, it acts on the mu-opioid receptor. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that drive breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 和芬太尼一樣，它作用於 μ 鴉片受體。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩驅動呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和芬太尼一样，它作用于 μ 鸦片受体。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓驱动呼吸的脑干中枢。

fact.en: It appeared on the black market in the early 1980s, and such analogues were part of what prompted the US Federal Analog Act, the first law to try to ban whole chemical families at once.
fact.zh: 它在 1980 年代初出現於黑市，這類類似物正是促成美國《聯邦類似物法》的原因之一，該法是首次嘗試一次禁止整個化學家族的法律。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1980 年代初出现于黑市，这类类似物正是促成美国《联邦类似物法》的原因之一，该法是首次尝试一次禁止整个化学家族的法律。
